server.name: surgeguard-mcp
server.title: SurgeGuard Policy-Gated Emergency Surge Planner
server.taskSupport: enabled for long-running forecast, optimization, simulation and sync operations

commonOperationalRules: Every mutating tool requires an idempotency key.
Every write is tenant scoped and transactionally audited.
A plan may execute only when its locked hash matches the approved hash.
Unresolved hard or critical violations block execution.
Exceptions require a rule marked overridable, matching authority, expiry and compensating controls.
Tools return policy evidence and warnings rather than silently relaxing constraints.
Long-running calls create MCP task records and support cancellation.

tools.name: get_system_health
tools.title: Get System Health
tools.description: Return MCP, database, policy-engine, optimizer and integration health without exposing secrets.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.title: Get Incident
tools.description: Return the incident command record, active operational period, objectives, assignments, hazards and open tasks.

tools.name: get_current_capacity
tools.title: Get Current Capacity
tools.description: Return licensed, staffed, operational, occupied, held, cleaning, blocked and surge-space capacity by location and care level.

tools.name: get_queue_pressure
tools.title: Get Queue Pressure
tools.description: Return active queues, service-level breaches, acuity mix and waiting-time distribution.

tools.name: get_staffing_readiness
tools.title: Get Staffing Readiness
tools.description: Return role coverage, qualifications, privileges, credential expiry, availability, overtime and fatigue risk.

tools.name: get_patient_placement_constraints
tools.title: Get Patient Placement Constraints
tools.description: Return only the facts required to determine safe location placement: acuity, isolation, equipment, care level and cohort compatibility.

tools.name: get_policy_gate
tools.title: Get Policy Gate
tools.description: Return rule evaluations, violations, evidence, accepted exceptions and unresolved hard constraints for a subject.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get Plan
tools.description: Return a candidate plan with assumptions, objective scores, actions, staffing, beds, supplies, transfers, policy evidence and approvals.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.title: Compare Plans
tools.description: Compare candidate plans across waiting time, safety, staffing, capacity, cost, reversibility, robustness and policy violations.

tools.name: get_execution_status
tools.title: Get Execution Status
tools.description: Return live plan execution, step status, deviations, acknowledgements, safety metrics and rollback readiness.

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.title: Get Audit Trail
tools.description: Return authorized, purpose-bound audit and provenance records for a bounded subject and time range.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.title: Create Incident
tools.description: Create an incident command record and initial facility scope.

tools.name: create_operational_period
tools.title: Create Operational Period
tools.description: Create the next bounded operational period with briefing and planning deadlines.

tools.name: create_scenario
tools.title: Create Scenario
tools.description: Create a planning scenario shell scoped to an incident, facility and horizon.

tools.name: capture_baseline
tools.title: Capture Baseline
tools.description: Capture an immutable, hash-addressed baseline of queues, beds, staff, supplies, devices and active patient constraints.

tools.name: run_demand_forecast
tools.title: Run Demand Forecast
tools.description: Run a registered forecasting model and persist forecast points with uncertainty bounds.

tools.name: generate_surge_plan
tools.title: Generate Surge Plan
tools.description: Generate ranked candidate plans using registered objectives, constraints and solver settings.

tools.name: evaluate_plan
tools.title: Evaluate Plan
tools.description: Evaluate a candidate plan against active policy rule sets and persist evidence-linked violations.

tools.name: simulate_plan
tools.title: Simulate Plan
tools.description: Run discrete-event or Monte Carlo simulation for a candidate plan without changing operations.

tools.name: request_policy_override
tools.title: Request Policy Override
tools.description: Request a narrowly scoped, time-bounded exception to an overridable policy violation with evidence and compensating controls.

tools.name: submit_plan_for_approval
tools.title: Submit Plan For Approval
tools.description: Lock the evaluated plan hash and start the configured approval workflow.

tools.name: decide_plan_approval
tools.title: Decide Plan Approval
tools.description: Record an authorized approval, rejection or request for changes against the locked plan hash.

tools.name: execute_plan
tools.title: Execute Plan
tools.description: Create an execution instance only for an approved plan whose current hash and pre-execution policy gate remain valid.

tools.name: activate_surge_space
tools.title: Activate Surge Space
tools.description: Activate a contingency or crisis space only after prerequisite, environmental, staffing and equipment checks.

tools.name: assign_staff
tools.title: Assign Staff
tools.description: Create an operational staffing assignment after credential, privilege, competency, availability, labor and fatigue checks.

tools.name: allocate_beds
tools.title: Allocate Beds
tools.description: Reserve or assign beds after care-level, isolation, cohort, equipment, gender, weight and occupancy checks.

tools.name: request_transfer
tools.title: Request Transfer
tools.description: Create a transfer request and required transport resources after destination eligibility and isolation checks.

tools.name: send_operational_message
tools.title: Send Operational Message
tools.description: Send an approved operational communication through configured channels with delivery and acknowledgement tracking.

tools.name: record_execution_deviation
tools.title: Record Execution Deviation
tools.description: Record an observed deviation, severity, actual state, corrective action and acceptance authority.

tools.name: rollback_plan_action
tools.title: Rollback Plan Action
tools.description: Run the registered rollback procedure for a reversible action after confirming current state and authority.

tools.name: import_policy
tools.title: Import Policy
tools.description: Import a policy document and create a draft policy record with source hash, jurisdiction and effective dates.

tools.name: publish_rule_set
tools.title: Publish Rule Set
tools.description: Publish an immutable rule-set release only after tests, evidence links, conflict analysis and authorized approval.

tools.name: test_policy_rule
tools.title: Test Policy Rule
tools.description: Execute deterministic rule tests and return fact-level evidence without publishing.

tools.name: sync_fhir
tools.title: Sync Fhir
tools.description: Run a bounded FHIR synchronization for authorized resource types and persist raw resources, links and checkpoints.

tools.name: replay_dead_letter
tools.title: Replay Dead Letter
tools.description: Replay a quarantined integration event after validation and with a new idempotency boundary.

prompts.name: incident_brief
prompts.description: Produce an evidence-linked command brief from current incident state.

prompts.name: compare_safe_options
prompts.description: Compare safe candidate plans without recommending any blocked plan.

prompts.name: shift_handoff
prompts.description: Produce a structured operational-period handoff with unresolved risks and owners.

prompts.name: after_action_review
prompts.description: Draft an evidence-linked after-action review from execution results and deviations.
